title: October 1964 Playboy - Centerfold Complete With Cassius Clay Interview
descriptionText: The product is a vintage October 1964 issue of Playboy magazine, featuring a complete centerfold with an interview of Cassius Clay. This edition includes illustrated articles and photographs related to art, photography, modeling, and lifestyle topics. Written in English, this magazine provides a glimpse into the popular culture and entertainment of the 1960s, making it a valuable collectible for fans of vintage magazines and memorabilia.
